metadata.description: Resource name prefix. Becomes part of every resource name. 3-15 chars, lowercase letters + digits + hyphens.
Web image source (Node API + React UI). Default: the public ghcr.io edge tag.
Worker image source (PowerShell crawler/scheduler). Separate from the web image.
Optional IP CIDR allow-list on the web ingress. Empty = open to internet.
Force re-run of the bootstrap deployment script. Bump this string to import a new image without changing other params.
VNet address space. Must contain both subnets.
Apps subnet (delegated to Container Apps). Must be /23 or larger.
Retention in days. Default 30. Container Apps logs are usually low-value past 30 days.
Principal IDs that should get AcrPull on this registry.
Principal IDs that should get AcrPush (used by the deployment script).
VNet ID to link to both zones
Private DNS zone ID for vaultcore.azure.net
Principal ID of the Web Container App managed identity (gets Secrets User)
Principal ID of the deployment-script identity (gets Secrets Officer to populate)
Pre-computed KV name (passed in by main.bicep so an `existing` reference can use the same static value).
Managed identity resource ID that runs this script
Key Vault name to write secrets into
ACR name to push the image into
Worker image source. The worker uses a separate image — PowerShell-based.
Destination web image tag in ACR.
Destination worker image tag in ACR.
Force re-run of the script on each deployment (useful when changing source image).

properties.scriptContent:
set -euo pipefail

echo "==> Generating master key (if absent)"
if ! az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name identityatlas-master-key >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  MASTER_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
  az keyvault secret set \
    --vault-name "$KV_NAME" \
    --name identityatlas-master-key \
    --value "$MASTER_KEY" \
    --output none
  echo "    wrote identityatlas-master-key"
else
  echo "    identityatlas-master-key already present, skipping"
fi

echo "==> Generating postgres admin password (if absent)"
if ! az keyvault secret show --vault-name "$KV_NAME" --name postgres-admin-password >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  PG_PASS=$(openssl rand -base64 24 | tr -d '/+=' | head -c 24)
  az keyvault secret set \
    --vault-name "$KV_NAME" \
    --name postgres-admin-password \
    --value "$PG_PASS" \
    --output none
  echo "    wrote postgres-admin-password"
else
  echo "    postgres-admin-password already present, skipping"
fi

echo "==> Importing web image $WEB_SOURCE_IMAGE into ACR $ACR_NAME as $WEB_DEST_IMAGE"
az acr import \
  --name "$ACR_NAME" \
  --source "$WEB_SOURCE_IMAGE" \
  --image "$WEB_DEST_IMAGE" \
  --force \
  --output none
echo "    web image imported"

echo "==> Importing worker image $WORKER_SOURCE_IMAGE into ACR $ACR_NAME as $WORKER_DEST_IMAGE"
az acr import \
  --name "$ACR_NAME" \
  --source "$WORKER_SOURCE_IMAGE" \
  --image "$WORKER_DEST_IMAGE" \
  --force \
  --output none
echo "    worker image imported"

echo "==> Done"
